name: PCMFlowUDP
description: UDP transport adapter for PCMFlow. Provides RawUdpSink / RawUdpStream for caller-defined payloads and VbanSender / VbanReceiver for interoperability with VB-Audio Voicemeeter and VBAN Receptor (audio sub-protocol subset; not a full VBAN implementation). Codes against the Arduino UDP base class, so it works with WiFiUDP on ESP32 and on the lang-ship:host (1.0.6+) test target. No third-party vendored code; MIT.
keywords: audio, udp, vban, voicemeeter, streaming, network, esp32, pcmflow
